data.name: Sample - Proxmox - 1.0.0
data.description: Sample playbooks for "Proxmox" connector. If you are planning to use any of the sample playbooks in your environment, ensure that you clone those playbooks and move them to a different collection, since the sample playbook collection gets deleted during connector upgrade and delete.

workflows.name: Destroy Container
workflows.description: Sample: Stops and deletes an LXC container (Stop Container, Destroy Container). Adjust VMID and node.

workflows.name: Test Proxmox Connection
workflows.description: Sample: Retrieves the Proxmox version (Get Version). Verifies connectivity to the configured Proxmox instance.

workflows.name: API Request Generic
workflows.description: Sample: Generic API request (API Request). Adjust method and url_path, for example GET nodes/pve/status.

workflows.name: Get Next VMID
workflows.description: Sample: Gets the next available VMID (Get Next VMID) from the configured Proxmox instance.

workflows.name: Clone VM
workflows.description: Sample: Clones a VM from a template (Clone VM). Adjust node, template VMID, new VMID and name, or pass them via variables.

workflows.name: Destroy VM
workflows.description: Sample: Stops and deletes a VM (Stop VM, Destroy VM). Adjust VMID and node, or pass them via variables.

workflows.name: List VMs
workflows.description: Sample: Lists all VMs on the node (List VMs). Adjust node (for example pve).

workflows.name: Create Container
workflows.description: Sample: Creates an LXC container (Create Container). Adjust node, VMID, hostname, template and net0.

workflows.name: List Containers
workflows.description: Sample: Lists all LXC containers on the node (List Containers). Adjust node (for example pve).

workflows.name: Configure VM
workflows.description: Sample: Configures a VM (Configure VM). Adjust body_params such as ipconfig0 and nameserver.

workflows.name: Get Nodes
workflows.description: Sample: Lists all cluster nodes and their status (Get Nodes). Verifies that the Proxmox cluster is reachable.

workflows.name: Start VM
workflows.description: Sample: Starts a VM (Start VM). Adjust node and VMID.

workflows.name: Get Task Status
workflows.description: Sample: Queries the status of an asynchronous task (Get Task Status). Use the UPID from the clone/create response.

workflows.name: Start Container
workflows.description: Sample: Starts an LXC container (Start Container). Adjust node and VMID.

workflows.name: Stop Container
workflows.description: Sample: Stops an LXC container (Stop Container). Adjust node and VMID.
